question_RU: Какая доля угловой вариации полей и выделенной картины описывается низкими угловыми компонентами, и где остаётся невязка?
angular_coordinates: original QLM theta=(i+0.5)*pi/35, phi=j*2*pi/72, simulation frame held fixed
measure: saved normalized physical area weights from B4; do not reconstruct again
approximation: weighted least squares in real spherical harmonic subspaces 0<=ell<=L
real_basis: Y_l0; sqrt(2)*Re(Y_lm) and sqrt(2)*Im(Y_lm) for m>0, with explicit normalization and phase convention
additional_metrics: singular values and design-matrix condition number
weighted overlap of original saved 95% mask and a residual 95% mask
residual concentration in the saved original mask
pre_fit_checks: finite positive weights and 2520 matching angular nodes
full column rank and numerical conditioning
clear distinction between coordinate spherical harmonics and intrinsic Laplacian eigenfunctions
inference_scope: descriptive only; no null significance, detection threshold, new-physics claim or Kerr/QNM fit
abs_sigma_scope: scalar approximation of the magnitude only, not a spin-weighted decomposition of complex shear
future_interpretation: A good low-degree approximation describes the pattern but does not prove a unique physical cause.
A residual can reflect higher angular content, coordinates, tetrad choices and numerical errors.
No transfer of HF1 or Yitian multipole definitions to QC0.
